description: Search 200M+ academic papers by title and abstract text across all fields of study. Returns Semantic Scholar paper ID, DOI, title, year, venue, authors, citation count, and open-access PDF link when available. Complements openalex.works_search (broader topic classification) with Semantic Scholar's AI-driven relevance ranking and TLDR summaries. Call semanticscholar.get_paper with a result paper_id, DOI, or ArXiv ID for full detail including abstract and TLDR. Data: api.semanticscholar.org, no auth required.

limit.description: Number of results to return (1-25, default 10)

query.description: Search query across paper title and abstract (e.g. "transformer attention")

name: semanticscholar.papers.search

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Semantic Scholar Papers Search
